observed_before_this_amendment.sft: The one authorized 32-step SFT run completed. It will not be repeated.
observed_before_this_amendment.later_merged_checkpoints: No merged checkpoint after step 21 has been created or scored.

correction.reason: The original adapter-versus-merged 2e-5 equality gate is not a valid deployment criterion for this BF16/vLLM path. Runtime LoRA application and BF16 weight merging are numerically different policies. The scientific requirement is adequate support in the policy actually deployed to all three arms.
correction.replaces: The original merge_gate equality criterion only. It does not alter the SFT run, reward data, branch estimator, campaign arms, call budgets, thresholds, seeds, execution order, or decision rule.
correction.deployed_candidate_order: Start with the already observed step 21 merged model, then merge and score steps 22 through 32 in strict ascending contiguous order.
correction.selection: Select the earliest merged checkpoint satisfying every unchanged support bound. Stop immediately after the first passing candidate.
correction.backend: The same pinned authoritative vLLM full-vocabulary scorer and exact temperature reweighting used by the original protocol.
correction.failure: If no merged checkpoint through step 32 passes, record a terminal warm-start failure, sync compact evidence, terminate compute, and do not run any RL arm.
correction.post_selection_freeze: Before the first RL model call, record and commit the exact selected step, selected adapter hash, deployed merged-model manifest, deployed score hash, and campaign model path.
